name: Craft
description: Craft is a notes and docs app that combines block-based writing with tasks, calendar events, and whiteboards, letting users capture ideas quickly on any device and refine them into polished, shareable documents.
best_for: Positioned for individuals and teams who want a unified, design-focused workspace for notes, daily journaling, and documents that can be published or shared directly from the app.
features: Block-based documents supporting docs, tasks, calendar events, and whiteboards
Daily Notes for daily capture and reflection
AI writing assistance for composing and refining content
Templates for jumpstarting different project types
Direct publishing and sharing from within the app
Cross-device sync for capturing ideas instantly and refining them later
MCP and API integrations with tools like Claude, ChatGPT, and Apple Shortcuts

alternatives.name: Notion
alternatives.description: An all-in-one workspace combining documents, databases, project tracking, and team knowledge.
alternatives.best_for: Users who want structured databases alongside documents

alternatives.name: Evernote
alternatives.description: A note-taking app for capturing, organizing, and searching notes, documents, and web clippings.
alternatives.best_for: Users who want strong web clipping and document scanning

alternatives.name: Microsoft OneNote
alternatives.description: A free-form digital note-taking app organized into notebooks, sections, and pages with handwriting support.
alternatives.best_for: Users already in the Microsoft ecosystem
